base_gate: close when deltaAR > 1.5; open when deltaAR < 0; hold otherwise; multiplied by TIP>0; next-day effect

variants.V2b_change_only: close only when (deltaAR_t - deltaAR_{t-5}) > 0.5 (diagnostic, not a candidate)

evaluation: same 18-industry + empty-intersection fallback selection, index returns, 2019-08-01~2026-07-31; report 2019-2023, 2024-2026, full and yearly
decision_rule: adopt only if the gain is not confined to a single year and full-period Sharpe is not lower than the base
note: both variants were suggested after inspecting the base; treat any gain as exploratory
